entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I'm calling about an order... I'm just really sad about it. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes a little over a month ago.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I was so excited for them, I really was. But they're just not working out.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered 39 days ago. What specifically is the issue with them?
They gave me terrible blisters. I tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, thinking that was the problem, but the pressure points are just awful. I can't even get through a short ride without pain.
That definitely sounds uncomfortable, and I'm sorry they're causing you blisters. That's not the experience we want for our customers.
I've been a loyal customer for years, and I was just really hoping I could get a refund. I honestly feel bad asking, but with the holidays just over, I really needed this money back.

There's no need to feel bad at all. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment. Okay, yes. Our standard return policy is 90 days. Since you received the shoes 39 days ago, you are well within the window.
Oh, really? So I can return them?

Absolutely. I can process that refund for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, you'll see the full refund processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Wow, that is such a relief. Thank you so much, David. You've really helped me out today. I was so worried.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
